{"id": "b887d44b-69d7-4b90-b38d-0e6e3e36dcbb", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "I can't directly SSM into an instance and restart the agent myself — I don't have a shell/exec tool for that. But let me actually help solve this instead of just telling you I can't.

A couple of things I can do right now:
1. Look up the instance's current SSM status and recent fleet/ping history to confirm what's going on
2. Check if it's reachable another way (e.g., via EC2 status checks, or if it has a way to run commands like `run_command` through SSM targeting other healthy instances, or via user-data/EventBridge)

Restarting the SSM agent on a box that's already `ConnectionLost` typically can't be done *through* SSM (that's the chicken-and-egg problem — Run Command needs the agent to be reachable). The usual fixes are: reboot via EC2 API, use EC2 Instance Connect/serial console to restart the agent manually, or check IAM role/network/endpoint issues causing the disconnect in the first place.
